verdict.rationale: Lovable's Git Sync explicitly connects a project to a GitHub/GitLab repo you own and keeps both in sync automatically, supporting local IDE work with commit/push flowing back into Lovable, plus PR review, branching, and backups. This directly matches the two-way sync story with clear first-party documentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that sync reliably handles complex merge conflicts or large-scale bidirectional edits at scale.
